description: Tracks in-flight async operations (save, export, upload, sync) that the user should know are pending.

members.name: Add
members.description: Registers or updates a pending action. If an action with id already exists its message is replaced.

members.name: GetMessage
members.description: Returns the message for a pending action, or null when the action is not registered.

members.name: Remove
members.description: Removes the pending action with the given id. No-op if not found.
